statement: A one-shot Linux admission component authenticates a trusted listener channel, binds same-repository push or pull-request metadata to a private job/run/attempt plan, and refuses invalid assignments before worker creation. It executes a protected descriptor with sealed assignment stdin, separate worker credentials and a fresh environment. Registered offline regressions model privileged ownership and account transitions; they do not qualify a deployed host. No Linux routing is enabled. Listener/worker integration, authenticated metadata normalization, descendant containment, cancellation, startup/lifetime bounds, replay prevention and integrated host qualification remain required before activation; LUM_SELF_HOSTED defaults to disabled.

evidence.planned: Implement pinned listener/worker integration, containment and deployed-host qualification before activation; owner: maintainers
